description: This file contains utility functions and constants related to Kubernetes nodes, including address preference, IP retrieval, and readiness status.

classes.name: NoMatchError
classes.description: A custom error type indicating no matching node address was found.

methods.name: Error
methods.description: Returns a formatted error message for NoMatchError.

methods.name: GetPreferredNodeAddress
methods.description: Returns the preferred address of a node based on a list of preferred address types.

methods.name: GetNodeHostIPs
methods.description: Retrieves the node's IP addresses, handling both single and dual-stack configurations.

methods.name: IsNodeReady
methods.description: Checks if a node's status condition indicates it is ready.
